const CB_NULL = {
    callback: () => { throw new RangeError("attempted to call a callback at NULL") },
    data: null
};
const CB_UNDEFINED = {
    callback: () => { throw new RangeError("attempted to call an uninitialized callback") },
    data: null
};

class Scope {
    constructor() {
        this.nextId = 1;
        this.callbackMap = new Map();
        this.callbackMap.set(0, CB_NULL);
    }

    addCallback(callback, data) {
        let id = this.nextId++;
        this.callbackMap.set(id, {callback, data});
        return id;
    }

    getCallback(id) {
        return this.callbackMap.get(id) || CB_UNDEFINED;
    }

    deleteCallback(id) {
        this.callbackMap.delete(id);
    }

    release() {
        this.callbackMap = null;
    }
}


const GLOBAL_SCOPE = new Scope();
let scope = GLOBAL_SCOPE;



function _callCallback(callbackId, global = false) {
    let callback = (global ? GLOBAL_SCOPE : scope).getCallback(callbackId);
    try {
        callback.callback();
        return callback.data;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(e)
    }
}

function _registerCallback(callback, data = null, global = false) {
    return (global ? GLOBAL_SCOPE : scope).addCallback(callback, data);
}

function _releaseCallback(callbackId, global = false) {
    (global ? GLOBAL_SCOPE : scope).deleteCallback(callbackId);
}

function _createLocalCallbackScope() {
    if (scope !== GLOBAL_SCOPE) {
        throw new Error("attempted to overwrite local scope")
    }
    scope = new Scope()
}

function _releaseLocalCallbackScope() {
    if (scope === GLOBAL_SCOPE) {
        throw new Error("attempted to release global scope")
    }
    scope.release()
    scope = GLOBAL_SCOPE
}

export const skikoApi = {

   var wordList by remember {\r\n        mutableStateOf(\r\n            try {\r\n                val saved = localStorage.getItem(\"word_list\")\r\n                if (saved != null) {\r\n - last) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24) === 1;\r\n                })()\r\n            \"\"\") as Boolean\r\n\r\n            val isSameDay = (lastStudy == currentDay)\r\n            if (!isSameDay) {\r\n                if (isConsecutive) {\r\n                    currentStreak++\r\n                } else if (lastStudy.isEmpty()) {\r\n                    currentStreak = 1\r\n                } else {\r\n                    val diffDays = js(\"\"\"\r\n                        (function() {\r\n                            const last = new Date(lastStudy.slice(0,4), lastStudy.slice(4,6)-1, / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24);\r\n                        })()\r\n                    \"\"\") as Double\r\n                    if (diffDays > 1.0) currentStreak = 1\r\n                }\r\n                localStorage.setItem(\"last_study_date\", currentDay)\r\n                localStorage.setItem(\"current_streak\", currentStreak.toString())\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    val incrementWrongCount: (Word) -> Unit = { word ->\r\n        val key = \"${word.category}_${word.fileName}_${word.id}\"\r\n        wrongCounts = wrongCounts + (key to ((wrongCounts[key] ?: 0) + 1))\r\n        val now = (js(\"Date.now()\") as Number).toLong()\r\n        lastWrongTimes = lastWrongTimes + (key to now)\r\n        updateStudyStats(false)\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    val recordCorrectAnswer: (Word) -> Unit = { word ->\r\n        val key = \"${word.category}_${word.fileName}_${word.id}\"\r\n        correctCounts = correctCounts + (key to ((correctCounts[key] ?: 0) + 1))\r\n        updateStudyStats(true)\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    val undoWrongAnswer: (Word) -> Unit = { word ->\r\n        val key = \"${word.category}_${word.fileName}_${word.id}\"\r\n        val current = }\r\n        if (todayTotal > 0) {\r\n            todayTotal--\r\n            localStorage.setItem(\"today_total\", todayTotal.toString())\r\n        }\r\n        val currentDay = getTodayStr()\r\n        val graphCount = weeklyHistory[currentDay] ?: 0\r\n        if (graphCount > 0) {\r\n            weeklyHistory = weeklyHistory + (currentDay to (graphCount - 1))\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    val undoCorrectAnswer: (Word) -> Unit = { word ->\r\n        val key = \"${word.category}_${word.fileName}_${word.id}\"\r\n        val current = correctCounts[key] ?: 0\r\n        if (current > 1) localStorage.setItem(\"today_correct\", todayCorrect.toString())\r\n        }\r\n        val currentDay = getTodayStr()\r\n        val graphCount = weeklyHistory[currentDay] ?: 0\r\n        if japanese, category, fileName ->\r\n        val files = categoryFiles[category] ?: listOf(\"デフォルト\")\r\n        val targetFile = if (files.contains(fileName)) fileName else {\r\n            categoryFiles = categoryFiles + (category to (files + fileName))\r\n            fileName\r\n        }\r\n        val catWords = wordList.filter { it.category == category && it.fileName == targetFile }\r\n        val tempId = catWords.size + 1\r\n        val newWord = Word(tempId, english, japanese, category, targetFile)\r\n        val addedList = wordList + newWord\r\n        wordList = categoryFiles = categoryFiles + (category to files.map { if (it == oldName) trimmed else it })\r\n            wordList = wordList.map { if (it.category == category && it.fileName == oldName) by remember { mutableStateOf(\"general\") }\r\n    var selectedCategoryName by remember { mutableStateOf(\"一般\") }\r\n    var selectedFileName by remember { mutableStateOf(\"デフォルト\") }\r\n    var csvLines.joinToString(\"\\n\")\r\n\r\n    js(\"\"\"\r\n        (function(content, name) {\r\n            const blob = new Blob([content], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });\r\n            const url \"\"\")\r\n}\r\n\r\n@Composable\r\nfun WeeklyProgressChart(weeklyHistory: Map<String, Int>) {\r\n    Card(\r\n        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),\r\n        colors = }\r\n}\r\n\r\nfun launchExcelImport(category: String, onImported: (String, List<Pair<String, String>>) -> Unit) {\r\n    val input = document.createElement(\"input\") as HTMLInputElement\r\n    input.type = \"file\"\r\n    input.accept = \".xlsx, .xls, .csv\"\r\n    input.onchange = {\r\n        val file = input.files?.item(0)\r\n        if (file != null) {\r\n            val fileNameWithoutExt = file.name.substringBeforeLast(\".\")\r\n            val reader = FileReader()\r\n            if (file.name.endsWith(\".csv\", ignoreCase = true)) {\r\n                reader.onload = { _ ->\r\n                    val text = reader.result as? String ?: \"\"\r\n                    val words = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()\r\n                    for (line in text.lines()) {\r\n                        val parts = line.split(\",\")\r\n                        if (parts.size >= 2) {\r\n                            val eng = parts[0].trim().removeSurrounding(\"\\\"\")\r\n                            val jap = parts[1].trim().removeSurrounding(\"\\\"\")\r\n                            if (eng.isNotBlank() && jap.isNotBlank() && eng.lowercase() != \"english\" && eng != \"英語\") {\r\n                                words.add(Pair(eng, jap))\r\n                            }\r\n                        }\r\n                    }\r\n                    if (words.isNotEmpty()) {\r\n                        onImported(fileNameWithoutExt, words)\r\n                    }\r\n                }\r\n                reader.readAsText(file)\r\n            } else {\r\n                reader.onload = { _ ->\r\n                    val arrayBuffer = reader.result\r\n                    try {\r\n                        val data = js(\"new Uint8Array(arrayBuffer)\")\r\n                        val workbook = js(\"XLSX.read(data, {type: 'array'})\")\r\n                        val firstSheetName = workbook.SheetNames[0]\r\n                        val worksheet = workbook.Sheets[firstSheetName]\r\n                        val json = js(\"XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(worksheet, {header: 1})\")\r\n\r\n                        val words = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()\r\n                        val length = js(\"json.length\") as Int\r\n                        for (i in 0 until length) {\r\n                            val row = js(\"json[i]\")\r\n                            if (row != null && js(\"row.length\") >= 2) {\r\n                                val eng = js(\"row[0]\")?.toString()?.trim() ?: \"\"\r\n                                val jap = js(\"row[1]\")?.toString()?.trim() ?: \"\"\r\n                                if (eng.isNotBlank() && jap.isNotBlank() && eng.lowercase() != \"english\" && eng != \"英語\") {\r\n                                    words.add(Pair(eng, jap))\r\n                                }\r\n                            }\r\n                        }\r\n                        if (words.isNotEmpty()) {\r\n                            onImported(fileNameWithoutExt, words)\r\n                        }\r\n                    } catch (e: Exception) {\r\n                        println(\"Excel parse error: $e\")\r\n                    }\r\n                }\r\n                reader.readAsArrayBuffer(file)\r\n            }\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n    input.click()\r\n}\r\n\r\n@Composable\r\nfun WordListScreen(\r\n    wordList:         start += 100\r\n            }\r\n            listOf(\"すべて\") + list\r\n        }\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    LaunchedEffect(selectedFileName, ranges) {\r\n        if (!ranges.contains(selectedRange)) selectedRange = \"すべて\"\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    val filteredWords = remember(fileWords, searchQuery, selectedRange, sortOrder, wrongCounts, correctCounts) {\r\n        val base = fileWords.filter { word ->\r\n            val matchRange = if (selectedRange == \"すべて\") true else {\r\n                val parts = selectedRange.split(\"-\")\r\n                val start = parts[0].toIntOrNull() ?: 1\r\n                val end = parts[1].toIntOrNull() ?: 100\r\n                word.id in start..end\r\n            }\r\n            val matchSearch = if (searchQuery.isBlank()) true else {\r\n                word.english.contains(searchQuery, ignoreCase = true) || word.japanese.contains(searchQuery)\r\n            }\r\n            matchRange && matchSearch\r\n        }\r\n\r\n        when (sortOrder)
